headline: ZCode documents no default OS sandbox for its shared Agent adapter and a yolo default for non-interactive CLI prompts
summary: The ZCode v3.15.1 repository commit dated 2026-10-10 includes a Chinese NOTICE stating that its shared Agent execution adapter has no default operating-system sandbox, and that standalone CLI --prompt calls default to yolo when --mode is omitted. The pinned CLI source defines that fallback, and its permission service describes prompt-bypass rules and exceptions. These findings are scoped to the documented adapter and non-interactive CLI path; no packaged runtime was tested.
